acceptance_predicates.description: Every human diagnostic states what the current command could not do, completed only partially, or completed with a warning.
Every known cause uses its fine-grained class and names the affected safe target or resource; generic words are never the sole explanation.
Output says whether relevant configuration, directories, artifacts, runs, or selections were created, retained, partially produced, or left unchanged.
Each recoverable case provides one valid context-specific command or a concrete correction; unsafe or non-idempotent retries are not suggested.
Warnings identify the exact limitation and consequence without presenting warning-only development conditions as failures.
Human usefulness does not leak credentials, payloads, prompts, internal temporary paths, or private evidence and does not change JSON schemas, exit meanings, or stream contracts.

definition_of_done: Every AR-1766 diagnostic variant and AR-1767 directory outcome has an explicit meaningful human presentation and test.
All public command-family negative and warning fixtures pass with cause, target, state-change, and remediation assertions.
Independent exact-head review and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: AR-1766 typed fine-grained causes, context, severity, and remediation metadata.
AR-1767 created/reused and path-specific preparation outcomes.

outputs.description: Cause-specific concise messages and validated recovery for every public error, failure, partial result, and warning.
Reviewed semantic and golden fixtures covering the complete catalog.

gates.description: Every fixture asserts precise outcome, cause, safe target, state-change result, and useful remediation.
Negative tests prove materially different causes cannot render the same ambiguous explanation.
JSON, exit codes, stdout/stderr, privacy, width, control-character, and shell-safety contracts remain green.
